name: QA-ATG
description: Benchmark generator, evaluation model, region selectors (APS-RS-QE, an angular sweep, four stepwise variants and six baseline selectors: four from the literature, a Hilbert-curve order and a global mapper), experiment scripts and results (71,160 simulation runs) of the paper "Quality-Adaptive Region Selection with Admission Pruning for Heterogeneous Partially Reconfigurable NoCs" (IEEE MCSoC 2026). The benchmark provides quality-adjustable streaming applications with standard quality ladders, accelerator areas calibrated against published FPGA designs, reconfiguration times from the 7-series frame structure, and platforms sized to Zynq-7000 devices. All data are regenerated deterministically from the configuration (python reproduce.py data) and checked against SHA-256 manifests. Code: MIT License. Configuration, data, manifests, results and documentation: CC BY 4.0. Version 1.0.1: paper title updated; baseline selectors renamed; fixed the att_with_admission column of results/tables/table4_s4h.csv (it also averaged the device-sized runs). Simulation code, data and all result CSVs are unchanged.
